Product Details

Polycab Etira 1.5 Sqmm 90m Red Single Core FR Multistrand PVC Insulated Unsheathed Industrial Cable is a high tension cable made of PVC. It is red in color and has a single core. Polycab unsheathed industrial cables are high tension cables made of flame retardant (FR) wire type and are available in lengths of 90 m. They have a voltage of 1100 V and a size (cross sectional area) of 1.5 sqmm. The cables are red in colour and made of PVC insulated material. They have a single core.
